name: broken-link-auditor
title: Site Migration QA & Broken Link Checker
description: Site migration QA: check that every old URL redirects to a live page. Paste a list of URLs, point at a sitemap, or crawl a site. Returns status, redirect chain, redirect loops, final URL, 404s and 5xx, response time and content type. Run it monthly for a broken-link report.
seoTitle: Site Migration QA: Broken Link & Redirect Checker
seoDescription: Check that every old URL redirects to a live page after a site migration. Finds 404s, redirect chains and loops. Run it monthly for a broken-link report.
